context: Boot workflow executed but produced no eval record. Workflow is not properly integrated with hook system for eval harness instrumentation.
what_happened: User ran boot workflow. No eval record was generated in systems/eval-harness/runs/. Boot workflow appears to rely on manual/unreliable eval generation rather than being integrated into the hook system.
expected: Boot workflow should be integrated with .claude/hooks/post-tool-use.py and .claude/hooks/eval-agent-stop.py to automatically capture step-level token data, generate proper eval records with required fields (type, trigger, model per-step, tokens_input, tokens_output, cost_usd, assessment blocks).
actual: Boot workflow completes without generating eval record. No hook-based instrumentation firing. Workflow relies on manual/implicit eval generation which is unreliable.
root_cause: Boot workflow (workflows/boot/workflow.md and its steps) are not integrated into the eval harness hook system. Hook integration is the mechanism that captures real token audit data and generates compliant eval records.
required_fix: Refactor boot workflow to be hook-integrated: (1) Add started/completed timestamps to all step frontmatter, (2) Ensure post-tool-use hook fires on step completions, (3) Integrate eval-agent-stop hook to generate final eval record with real token counts and required assessment blocks.
